description: Free. Expand YouTube URLs exactly as an ingest would and return the price, the per-video lines and the per-source rejections. Maps to POST /v1/quote. $0.01/min standard, $0.03/min whisper by default, 1-minute minimum per video. The `quote_id` is valid for 15 minutes; pass it to `transcribe` or `add_sources` to be charged exactly this price. Pass `collection_id` to price against an existing collection (videos already in it are free). At least one of url, urls, channel_url, channel_urls. Requires the key's `read` scope. Prices are the service defaults; `quote` returns the exact price.

collection_id.description: Price against this collection (videos already in it are free).

exclude_shorts.description: Skip videos of 3 minutes or less when expanding a channel or playlist (default true); explicit video URLs are never skipped.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 hint for transcription, e.g. en.

max_videos_per_channel.description: Newest-first cap on eligible videos per channel or playlist (default 25); Shorts and videos below min_duration_seconds are skipped before the cap.

min_duration_seconds.description: Skip expanded videos shorter than this many seconds.

name: quote
title: Quote an ingest
